entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems I've become too passionate.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm glad you were here.[n]You have my thanks.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I worry that you may not get what I mean.[n]It was a figure of speech.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was referring to Van Gogh's[n]brother, Theo.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Van Gogh did not achieve fame in[n]his lifetime, but found an admirer[n]and supporter in his brother.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, there aren't many who are willing[n]to deal with my... eccentricity.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: By the way, what's in your hand...?[n]A card?
It's the blank card[n]the Shadow dropped...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Whenever I see blank paper, I have[n]the urge to draw something on it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do you think? Not bad,[n]wouldn't you say? Soon enough,[n]my slump will be a thing of—

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My picture... turned into a real skill card?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If I can overcome this slump, I should[n]be able to aid our group like earlier—[n]perhaps even more so.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I know... Why don't we act as the[n]thieves we are and strike a deal?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. You can rely on me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Great. I promise your returns will[n]be well worth your cooperation.
I can sense Yusuke's trust in me...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Multiple cards were discovered[n]among your belongings—replicas[n]of the same design.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I don't have a clue how these cards[n]were used, but someone proficient[n]in the arts was close to you...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...What were you having this person do!?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have agreed to a new[n]contract. Excellent.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Use this new bond to strengthen[n]your circle of support.
entries.uk: Використайте цей новий зв'язок,[n]щоб зміцнити своє коло підтримки.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We've done enough for today; I've[n]completed a rough sketch. I'll[n]finish this back at the dorm.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll contact you once it's done.
